num_nodes: <int> Total number of nodes, each serving as both a potential facility location and a customer.
num_facilities: <int> Number of potential facility locations that may be opened.
num_customers: <int> Number of customers whose demand must be served.

nodes.demand: <float> Quantity of goods this customer requires to be shipped.
nodes.fixed_setup_cost: <float> One-time cost incurred to open a facility at this location.
nodes.disruption_probability: <float> Probability that a facility at this location becomes unavailable due to a disruptive event.
nodes.survival_probability: <float> Probability that a facility at this location remains operational and available to serve customers.

transportation_cost_matrix: <list[list[float]], shape [num_customers][num_facilities]> Per-unit shipping cost from each facility to each customer.
penalty_cost: <list[float], length num_customers> Per-unit cost incurred when a customer cannot be served by any open and operational facility.
